title: Define Group Motion Fields
summary: Added renderer-neutral group motion fields derived from semantic purpose, relative scene regions, reading direction, and traversal context. Fields select dominant direction, curvature family, reconciliation region, branch symmetry, depth plane, candidate families, and bounded cohesion without authoring concrete routes.
